hooks.name: format-after-implement
hooks.description: Run the formatter after implementation; block on failure.

hooks.name: plan-ready
hooks.description: Post the finished plan to sdd-tracker and ask for the next step.

critique.description: Pressure-test the plan with Plan Critic

features.description: Break the plan down into feature specs
features.args: break down plan ${plan.file} into individual feature files

stop.description: Stop here; I'll pick it up later

hooks.name: critique-ready
hooks.description: Post the plan critique to sdd-tracker and ask for the next step.

options.question: Critique of `${plan.file}` is ready (verdict: ${verdict.code}). What next?

revise.description: Revise the plan to address the critique
revise.args: revise ${plan.file} to address the critique in ${report.file}

features.description: Accept the plan and break it down into feature specs
features.args: break down plan ${plan.file} into individual feature files

stop.description: Stop here; I'll pick it up later

hooks.name: specs-ready
hooks.description: After a Plan Mode breakdown, tell sdd-tracker the specs are ready and offer implementation.

options.question: Feature specs for `${plan.file}` are ready (${summary:-done}). What next?

implement.description: Implement every feature in the plan, in row order

stop.description: Stop here; I'll review the specs first

hooks.name: implementation-ready
hooks.description: After a feature is implemented, committed and its PR opened, offer a review in sdd-tracker.

options.question: ${feature.id} (${feature.name}) is implemented and its PR is open. What next?

hooks.name: review-ready
hooks.description: Post the review verdict to sdd-tracker and ask whether to remediate.
